notes.title: 1.251.11 Update Released
notes.notes:
[b]Tech tree reset is now available! [/b]

There are conditions to resetting the club office tech tree and will be blocked until they are met. The following conditions to reset club office tech tree:

[list]
[*] Can only have 1 or less homegrown star players in squad
[*] Squad size must be 30 players or under
[/list]
[b]Daily deals[/b]

Visit the store each day to find new deals on tokens, card decks, shields, and more!

[b]Broadcast building ads on Desktop[/b]

The broadcast building is now up and running again on desktop. Ads will now be viewable in-game and will not have a cooldown. Note that on desktop there is less ad inventory, so it's still handy to have the game on your phone if you want to get more views each day.

[b]3D matches now hidden by default[/b]

3D match view controls have been disabled by default for new users signing up to the game. To enable, go to settings > debug > enable 3d match view controls. This is to make it even more obvious this is a work-in-progress, and to provide a more professional experience across the board for new users.

[b]Minor fixes & improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Improvements to friends search
[*] Fixed union rep teams colours showing jersey gradients during a match
[*] Fixed lobby being invisible immediately after joining a union
[*] Fixed being unable to run a training match during a ladder challenge
[*] Clicking on a players health donut opens treatment room to the current player
[*] Other fixes and improvements
[/list]

notes.title: HUGE BlackoutRugby World Cup Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://blackout-rugby.s3.amazonaws.com/website/releases/Huge-Update-Raw.jpg[/img]

🏟️ [b]Union Rep Teams[/b] — The first inter-union competitions are here! Including player nominations, lineup and game-plan voting, seasonal leagues with promotion and relegation, union stadiums, and club rewards which can be earned by up to 3 of the union's rep teams.

Wiki: https://blackout-games.fandom.com/wiki/Rep_Teams


🌏 [b]National Unions / International Leagues[/b] — A simplified version of club unions, but on a larger scale. All clubs in the game will be part of a National Union. A 4-season term of 3 qualifier league seasons culminating in a Blackout Rugby World Cup every 4 seasons. 

Wiki: https://blackout-games.fandom.com/wiki/National_Unions


🏆 [b]Blackout Rugby World Cup[/b] — All nations will start on 50.00 ranking points. There are 36 nations, but only the top 32 will take part in the world cup.

Wiki: https://blackout-games.fandom.com/wiki/National_Unions#Blackout_Rugby_World_Cup


🏉 [b]2D Match View[/b] — We're replacing the original jersey view with a 2D top-down view to give a better overview of how your tactics are playing out with a birdseye view of the whole field. The 3D experimental view remains, though while there are some improvements, it is still very much a work in progress.

notes.title: August 2021 Update: What’s happening at Blackout!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965984/72a731f4a163a51a7d1254b825fc7379293037f2.png[/img]

We’ve been busy in this interesting and exciting stage for the company, as we pull closer and closer to our goals and the to-do list grows shorter and shorter. Here’s some insight into what we’re up to:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965984/1e8e5dbed6a0f1b5551687202fbc152e6252b3d9.png[/img]

[h2]Mobile[/h2]
Mobile has been our primary focus for the past while, and we’re seeing steady progress in this field! We’ve been working hard on optimizing our game for both IOS and Android platforms, and are close to public testing, which is the next major milestone in our mobile development. This will allow us to iron out the kinks like bugs, and make the necessary quality of life improvements.

While on this surface, this doesn’t seem to affect desktop players, this couldn’t be further from the truth. Once mobile has been launched, Blackout Rugby will experience a new influx of players, boosting the in-game activity and competitive side of the game. The benefits of this include:

A more populated and active transfer market, providing you with more variety in the players you can buy.
A more competitive ladder, with new challengers seeking to make a name for their club.
The ability to manage your club on the go, with cross-play between mobile and PC!

[h2]Desktop[/h2]
While mobile is our #1 priority, we’re still ensuring Desktop is getting the required attention it needs. With QA (Quality Assurance) processes and polish, along with some additional new features we’re excited to announce in the near future.

We appreciate your ongoing support and patience with our game, and we’re thankful we have world-class fans, as we aim to produce world-class manager games!

notes.title: Unions Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965984/e0a61dca1971aa916db6c82b4ec8223add770208.png[/img]

[b]Here’s something that’s been in the works for a while, and it’s finally ready to release!
[/b]
This is our unique take on clans or guilds from other MMOs / massively multiplayer games. You can create or join a union, take in your Union dues, chat with other members, and start working on Union challenges to level-up the union.

This feature brings a great social element to Blackout Rugby, and is a great chance for you and your friends to work together to make your Union a thriving place for talented Managers.

We’re not finished just yet though. Many features such as competitions, are still to come, so keep an eye on the the horizon for those.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965984/3603fd2894387c80ce7d39739455fdec81cdd4e1.png[/img]

Some additional content with this new update: 

[b]Psychology Building [/b]– A new building providing daily decks of cards which help improve mental attributes including Form, Aggression, Composure, and Leadership.

[b]Player History [/b]–  You can now see the historical events of your players over time, to see how they have progressed over time.
